newsitem.title: USA: Shell sees Wood River unit back up Wed after fire.
newsitem.headline: Shell sees Wood River unit back up Wed after fire.

text.p: Shell Oil Co said it expects an alkylation unit at its Wood River, Illinois refinery which was idled by a fire on Tuesday to be back up by Wednesday.
A fire at the plant's gas furnace, which produces olefins and other products, also brought down the 20,000 barrels a day alkylation unit because of steam, according to a Shell spokeswoman.

Crude runs at the plant, which has a rated capacity to process 268,000 barrels a day, were affected by a proportionate amount, she said. But the unit is expected to come back on line on Wednesday, assuming the gas unit has cooled down sufficiently, she added.
